operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the visible-monodromy exponent correction as ledger 1269
operations.body: Ledger 1269 removes 1268's faithfulness restriction. For any finite action rho:H->GL(F_p^r), global power-Mackey compatibility is iff gcd(n,p*exp(im rho))=1. Invisible factors in ker rho add no resonance primes. Hostile controls: C15 acting through C3 survives n=5, and trivial C3 on F2 survives n=3; the full quotient exponent makes seven false-failure predictions across the tested range. Exact coverage is 7,560 checks over 60 cases. Visible means visible to the kernel action only; no physical chain transfer is inferred. No build was run.
